primary.metric: MUSIQ KonIQ10k raw score, higher is better
primary.definition: mean MUSIQ of five frames, 15..19 seconds at 1 Hz
primary.unit: one independently selected distinct benchmark prompt with one assigned seed
primary.test: exact two-sided binomial sign test, ties |difference| <= 1e-6 excluded
primary.null: P(PC score > FIFO score | not tied) = 0.5
primary.decision: reject H0 for benefit if p<.05 and wins>losses; reject for harm if reversed; otherwise do not reject H0

metrics: adjacent decoded frame mean absolute RGB difference (descriptive motion proxy)
steady generation seconds per video second

limitations: 20.0625 s at native 480x832, native shift 5, one seed per prompt
MUSIQ is frame quality, not prompt adherence or temporal coherence
Not a full VBench evaluation; benchmark prompts only
No early stopping or choosing a different primary metric after seeing results
No automatic change to default inference settings
The same 16 prompts/seeds as the exploratory 256p series; not an independent replication across resolutions
BF16 block offloading enabled identically in both conditions; timing is for this placement
